story: Kartikeya was born to defeat the demon Tarakasura, who could only be killed by a son of Shiva. Raised by the six Krittikas, the stars of the Pleiades, he grew six faces, led the army of the gods, and killed Taraka.
belief: As Murugan, he is one of the most loved gods of Tamil Nadu, worshipped as a young warrior and guide. Devotees carry the kavadi on Thaipusam as an act of devotion and penance.
turns: In the race around the world, he flew all the way round on his peacock while Ganesha just circled their parents and won. Hurt, he left Kailash and settled at Palani, choosing pride and distance over family.
facts: His six main temples in Tamil Nadu are called the Arupadai Veedu.
Huge crowds celebrate Thaipusam at the Batu Caves in Malaysia.
His spear, the Vel, was given to him by his mother Parvati.
lessons: Speed without wisdom can lose the race.
Don't let one loss push you away from your family.
more: Skanda Shashti celebrates his victory over the demon Surapadman in Tamil tradition.
In Karnataka and Kerala he is widely known as Subrahmanya.
